name: team1-fuji-pilot
description: Ask for a counter on Avalanche Fuji, then review and sign in your wallet.
long_description: Local pilot: one owner-controlled counter starter, a pinned compiler, a downloadable deployment manifest and interrupted-transaction recovery. No private keys, API keys, AI editor or terminal commands are required for a Claude Desktop user after installing this bundle. A browser wallet with Fuji test AVAX is required. Mainnet is deliberately unavailable and needs a separate reviewed release.

tools.name: prepare_deployment
tools.description: Prepare the bundled counter on Fuji and return its human wallet signing link.

tools.name: deployment_status
tools.description: Reconcile a prepared deployment without sending another transaction.

tools.name: avalanche_help
tools.description: Read pilot help and AvaKit-based Fuji configuration.
